description: This Dart source file defines a CartProvider class which manages shopping cart state within a Flutter application. It handles adding, removing, updating items, persistence with shared preferences, and calculation of bill summary details.

classes.name: CartProvider
classes.description: Manages local shopping cart state, sum of items, billing calculations, and persistence.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an item to the cart; updates quantity if item already exists.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an item from the cart based on book ID.

methods.name: updateQty
methods.description: Updates the quantity for a specific book in the cart, with bounds between 1 and 99.

methods.name: _persist
methods.description: Saves the current cart items to shared preferences in JSON format.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores cart state from shared preferences storage.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart and updates persistence.
